description: Use when you need solar energy arithmetic from supplied assumptions; see Data APIs. Off-grid PV energy-balance estimate based on Wattpath by Nomad Energy Club. Supply daily loads, peak sun hours, PV losses, and optional battery assumptions. No location/weather lookup, electrical design, surge or installation certification. $0.02 per calculation; no stored inputs. Price: 0.02 USDC. Minimal input example: {"loads":[{"watts":100,"hours_per_day":5,"quantity":1,"kind":"dc"}],"peak_sun_hours":4,"pv_loss_fraction":0.2,"panel_watts":200,"battery":{"voltage":12,"usable_fraction":0.8,"autonomy_days":2}}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"daily_energy_wh":{"battery_side":400},"pv":{"minimum_nameplate_watts":125,"rounded_up_watts":125},"assumptions":{"energy_balance_only":true,"weather_or_location_lookup":false}}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

battery.description: Optional. Battery assumptions object. Example: {"voltage":12,"usable_fraction":0.8,"autonomy_days":2}. Omit to skip battery sizing.

autonomy_days.description: Required. Required energy autonomy number in days, greater than 0 and at most 30. Example: 2.

existing_capacity_ah.description: Optional. Existing battery capacity number in ampere-hours, 0–1000000. Example: 100. Omit when not comparing existing capacity.

usable_fraction.description: Required. Usable battery capacity fraction number, 0.05–1. Example: 0.8 means 80%.

voltage.description: Required. Battery voltage number in volts, 1–1000. Example: 12.

inverter_efficiency.description: Optional. Inverter efficiency fraction number, 0.1–1. Example: 0.9 means 90%. Required when any load has kind ac; otherwise optional.

loads.description: Required. Array of 1–50 load objects describing watts, hours_per_day, quantity and ac/dc kind. Example: [{"watts":60,"hours_per_day":4,"quantity":1,"kind":"dc"}].

hours_per_day.description: Required. Daily operating time number in hours, 0–24. Example: 4.

kind.description: Required. Load power type enum string: ac or dc. Example: dc. AC loads require inverter_efficiency.

quantity.description: Optional. Device count integer, 1–100. Example: 2. Defaults to 1.

watts.description: Required. Per-device power number in watts, 0–100000. Example: 60.

panel_watts.description: Optional. Individual panel rated power number in watts, 1–2000. Example: 400. Supply to estimate panel count.

peak_sun_hours.description: Required. Equivalent daily full-sun hours number, 0.01–24 for a usable estimate. Example: 4.5. Supply your own site assumption; no weather lookup.

pv_loss_fraction.description: Required. PV loss fraction number, 0–0.95, not a percentage. Example: 0.2 means 20% loss.
